resampling.fit: Aspect-preserving whole component, centered horizontally, anchored to bottom; one source-to-native reduction.
resampling.source_crop_completeness: Each whole alpha component includes head, tusks, shoulder spikes, complete hands/weapon, legs and boots. Source at/beyond a nominal sheet quarter is retained.

warrior_trainer.palette_fit: Explicitly lossy nearest-source RGB555+hue fit, with per8x8 material guards: head3 brown/ivory, outer shoulder/weapon row3/5/7 world or3/4 lodge. No anatomy was painted, moved or cropped; all nearest24 alpha pixels retained.
warrior_trainer.limitation: Downsampling the new illustration to24px and fitting three opaque colors per8x8 tile is lossy. World palette7 represents crimson with its available red/gold pair; lodge palette4 preserves steel/red directly.
warrior_trainer.native_pose_note: Four supplied generated stills, repeated at12 addresses; no fake walking pose or direction mirror.
